| description = Place Holders for [[an ancient croc]]. They are not social. Their proximity aggro range is very short, almost melee range.

All of the saltwater crocs spawn at the same time (and at the same level as each other), and the respawn timer is not reset until they are all killed. They can spawn anywhere from 1-5 saltwater crocs. The ancient croc will always spawn alone. 16 min, 30 second respawn time.
